'''2009 Bespin Regionals Brady Moore LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brady Moore]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' B. Moore
* '''Deck name:''' WYS
* '''Username:''' brady1194
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
